predictions.prediction_text: VIX vega will move up on shorter tenors, potentially causing an SPX squeeze up into July 4.
predictions.expected_result: VIX implied volatility on short-dated options increases and SPX rallies into early July, with spot reaching a new local high by July 4.

predictions.prediction_text: Vomma selling will remain into July.
predictions.expected_result: Implied volatility curvature (vomma) on monthly-tenor options decreases through July, reflected in lower VIX option convexity measures.

predictions.prediction_text: If VIX holds firmly below 16.5, volatility can start to catch a bid that would have a suppressive effect on the index.
predictions.expected_result: SPX experiences downward pressure or fails to make sustained new highs while realized/near-term implied volatility begins to rise.

predictions.prediction_text: I expect SPX/yields beta to go back to positive and trigger a coordinated selling flow on a ‘no-cut’ scenario.
predictions.condition: Fed does not cut rates at upcoming decision
predictions.expected_result: SPX declines in correlation with rising yields, producing a sustained selling flow across equities over subsequent sessions.

predictions.prediction_text: If July 8-9 pushes SPX back after a potential squeeze up out of short vanna regime, then a vol grind up can start slowly in a stairstep manner.
predictions.condition: SPX is pushed back on July 8-9 following an early-July squeeze
predictions.expected_result: After July 9, implied volatility increases gradually in stepwise increments while SPX trends lower or ranges, indicating a gradual vol grind up.

predictions.prediction_text: Until August we can expect net rangebounding while accumulating zomma and vomma risk, with vol spikes managed through vol-of-vol supply if the regime can’t shift.
predictions.expected_result: SPX trades in a broad range through July into August while option market shows increasing exposure to zomma/vomma risk and occasional short-lived vol spikes that are quickly damped by supply in vol-of-vol products.

predictions.prediction_text: Sentiment is artificially held up on dovish hopes, pricing in a dovish tilt into July FOMC.
predictions.expected_result: Markets exhibit upbeat price action leading into the July FOMC despite weak economic data, with prices weakening if dovish expectations are not met.
